title: Leon Kennedy's first day from hell in Resident Evil 2
subject: leon
description:
Would you have survived Leon's first shift? 👇

How a rookie cop's first day in Raccoon City turned Leon S. Kennedy into a survivor. Spoilers for Resident Evil 2.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Leon Kennedy's first day as a cop was his city's last.
In 1998, the 21-year-old rookie drove into Raccoon City, already late for his first shift.
Umbrella's virus had already turned almost everyone there into the walking dead.
At a gas station, he met Claire Redfield, a student searching for her missing brother.
Inside the police station, a woman named Ada Wong said she was FBI. She was lying.
Leon got Claire and a little girl, Sherry Birkin, onto a train before a missile erased the city.
